decisions.reason: It remains close to the core condenser business and the growing firm can still afford to wait, but after another year the overlap with nearby offerings makes portfolio pruning somewhat more plausible.

Management would keep this adjacent condenser option open because uncertainty may still clear with further market exposure, though similarity to other new condenser products raises the chance of rationalization if demand stays indistinct.
The tube-liner product fits the retrofit and repair logic of the service business, likely costs little to maintain, and continued availability preserves upside in corrosion-related demand.

This customized air-cooler line strongly matches the firm's integrated solution strategy and broad engineering capabilities, so keeping it offers the highest option value and the lowest near-term reason to exit.

These repair inserts complement lifecycle services and use existing customer relationships and technical know-how, so the firm would keep them while continuing to learn the scale of recurring service demand.
